title: Hand Back To Discussion Output
description: The record of one hand-back: where it was shown, its state, the person's answer quoted, how every copy was marked answered, and proof the answer reached the sibling. A dismissed card is not an answer.

shown.description: One entry per copy, the discussion's first.

ref.description: Message id, card id, sheet cell (tab!header/row key) or comment URL.

card.description: The card's id when this copy offered one.

state.description: open: waiting. answered: the person chose, in any channel. withdrawn: the question no longer needs an answer. superseded: a later hand-back replaced it. informed: a context, result or blocker that needed no answer was shown.

ask.description: The ask-the-person output, when the hand-back carried a question.

chosen.description: The letter chosen; null unless answered.

quote.description: The person's answer verbatim, with who, when and the message id or sheet cell it came from.

answeredIn.description: Which copy the answer came from.

marked.description: How each copy was closed once answered or withdrawn. A chat copy keeps its text: the question is struck through and "[Edit: <letter> chosen by <who>, <time>]" added, so the record still says what was asked. A sheet copy's "Decision needed" block is replaced by the decision and who made it.

edit.description: The text applied, e.g. "~~Which layout?~~ [Edit: A chosen by litlfred, 2026-10-31 15:50Z]".

deliveredBack.description: Proof the answer reached the sibling; null only while open or for state informed.

ref.description: The message id of the delivery.

citesPerson.description: true when the person's own message was attached by id, so the sibling may treat it as the person's approval. A paraphrase is never approval.
